skill_name: dev-team plugin (idea-refine, spec-writing, architecture-design, pipeline-design, test-planning, build-planning, build-setup, reference-intake)
harness: harness/driver.py + harness/grade.py (+ simulate.py, dtprobe.py via dt); see evals/README.md

evals.name: rl-incremental
evals.prompt: Multi-turn: simulated user (see harness/scenarios.json persona+facts) reveals one stage at a time: snake → fish → foraging. Each stage goes idea/brief → spec → architecture → pipelines → test plan (optional) → build plan; build setup before the first build. The whole dev-team plugin is loaded with --plugin-dir.
evals.expected_output: docs/brief.md (Accepted), docs/roadmap.md (a row per stage, each cut into milestone rows; derived status), docs/ideas/*.md (incremental), docs/spec.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/packages/<pkg>/{contract,pipelines,tests}.md, tasks/plan.md + todo.md (+ tasks/queued/ in incremental), CONSTRAINTS.md and the build-setup files, all Approved, dt-lint clean, gated one layer per turn, no code under src/ or tests/{intent,unit}/
assertions: [finished] Trajectory finished: simulated user reached the final stage and signed off
[define_design_approved] Brief, spec and architecture all end Accepted/Approved
[plan_docs_approved] Pipelines, test plans, build plan and CONSTRAINTS.md exist and all end Approved
[brief_size] Brief stays about one page (<= 500 words)
[brief_goal_count] Brief has 3-5 numbered goals
[brief_goals_stage_neutral] Brief goals stay <= 5 and stage-neutral (stages live in the roadmap)
[brief_not_doing] Brief has a Not doing list with items
[spec_gwt] Every live spec requirement has a Given/When/Then criterion (QR-: a how-checked line)
[spec_ids_unique] Spec requirement IDs are unique
[spec_no_vendors] Spec names no vendors, libraries, or storage tech
[spec_baselines] Learning/model criteria name a baseline to beat
[arch_covers_spec] Architecture covers every live spec requirement (dt uncovered = 0)
[arch_no_stale] Architecture references no stale/removed spec IDs
[arch_decisions] Architecture records technical decisions as AD-NN entries (>= 3)
[arch_shape] Architecture shape is recorded
[no_lost_reqs] No spec requirement ID ever disappeared (removed ones struck through, not deleted)
[no_lost_decisions] No architecture decision ever deleted (superseded instead)
[spec_changelog] Spec changelog exists with >= 1 row per planning round
[dt_lint_clean] `dt lint` is clean (no errors)
[doc_budgets] Doc size budgets hold (no `dt lint` budget warnings; brief <= 500 words)
[spec_on_pipeline_or_deferred] Every live spec ID sits on a pipeline step (or its Covers) or is Deferred in a plan
[phase0_spine] Every pipeline of a planned milestone has a Phase 0 spine task (active and queued plans)
[tasks_well_formed] Every task: Read IDs resolve (`dt context` exits 0), size <= M, Mode follows the rule (or gives a Reason)
[context_packets_small] `dt context` packets are under 2,000 lines
[roadmap_rows] Every stage has at least one milestone row and every milestone maps to a stage, with derived status (`dt roadmap --check` exits 0)
[no_code_during_planning] No source code written during planning (nothing under src/, tests/intent/, tests/unit/ beyond empty or docstring-only files)
[gate_discipline] Every skill stops at its gate: no turn drafts two layers (brief/idea, references, spec, architecture, pipelines, tests, plan, setup) at once
[approval_after_user] Docs only flip to Accepted/Approved in a turn where the user approved
[skills_invoked] All six required planning skills were invoked (idea → build-setup)
[test_planning_invoked] test-planning ran (optional skill; the persona asks for golden cases)
[sim_replan_simulation] Replan simulation: editing PL-01 step `read_raw` (pipelines.md back to Draft) → pipeline-design Revise
[sim_replan_simulation] Replan simulation: while PL-01 is Draft → build-planning blocked (waiting for approval)
[sim_replan_simulation] Replan simulation: PL-01 re-approved after the plan → build-planning Replan, doc listed
[sim_replan_simulation] Replan simulation: M1-T03 Blocked → build-planning Replan, task listed
[sim_replan_simulation] Replan simulation: both files restored → build-planning back to `extend`
[sim_advance_simulation] Advance simulation: every todo item ticked, exit checkpoint open → not yet Advance
[sim_advance_simulation] Advance simulation: exit checkpoint ticked too → build-planning Advance
[sim_advance_simulation] Advance simulation: `dt archive` stubs the plan, the milestone derives Done, lint stays clean
[incremental_all_planned] Incremental: every revealed stage's milestone has a build plan (active or queued)
[spec_snake] Spec covers the snake environment
[spec_fish] Spec covers the fish environment
[spec_foraging] Spec covers the foraging environment
[arch_shared_core] Architecture has a shared core reused by all environments
[spec_env_baselines] Each environment's learning criterion beats a random or scripted baseline
[spec_cpu_budget] CPU training-time budget (~1 hour) is a quality requirement
[rl_single_package] Proof-of-concept stays single package (no premature monorepo)
